faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Die-Struck Brass Academic & Graduation Medals?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Die-Struck Brass Academic & Graduation Medals is 300 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $2.90/pc (300 pcs starter tier), $1.95/pc (500 pcs tier), and $1.42/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Die-Struck Brass Academic & Graduation Medals, and when is it waived?

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Die-Struck Brass Academic & Graduation Medals?

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Die-Struck Brass Academic & Graduation Medals?
